No hardcoded hex/hsl values in component rules. - Sole exception: the literal `rgba()` stops inside the `.liquid-glass` gradient recipe, which is a fixed effect specification. **2.3 Dark Mode** - Dark mode is the site's only and default theme; the full palette in 1.2 is the dark palette and must be defined entirely through CSS variables so a future light theme could be added by editing `style.css` only. - **Exception clause:** per the requested style ("Dark only — full"), ship a single dark theme; no light variant, no theme toggle, and no `localStorage` theme persistence are required for this project. **2.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment** - Build all layout structures with **Flexbox**. - **Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center`** unless there is an explicitly justified exception (e.g., `align-items: stretch` for equal-height pricing cards) — justify every exception with a CSS comment. - Mobile-first: rows convert to columns on small viewports; **horizontal scrolling must never occur** on any breakpoint (pay special attention to the hero video and marquee). **2.5 Framework & CSS Organization** - Use clean, hand-written custom CSS organized in native cascade layers: `@layer tokens, base, layout, components, utilities`.
